approval.technical: Check book provenance, geometry, camera, fidelity and asset integrity.
approval.artistic: Decision on each exact output by the owner.

cinema.prompt: Image edit for Praça Lindenberg Clodomiro. First reference is exact content and input; second is approved Residence Brooklin lighting and finish reference only. Produce a real cinematic re-render of the first image, premium architectural photography, subtle warm directional bounce and realistic contact shadows, tactile fine-grain materials, lifelike depth and natural highlights like the second image. Lock the entire camera perspective, crop, elevations, structure, openings, all exact equipment types, silhouettes and counts, orientation and placement, furniture and mirrors. No props or lamps added, removed or moved; do not import any architecture from the second image. Crisp readable equipment throughout, one full-frame image without letters, typography or frame. Transform the lighting, reflection, material fidelity and atmosphere as a generative edit.
cinema.replicationPrompt: Image edit. First reference is exact content and input; second is approved Praça Lindenberg Clodomiro Cinema lighting and finish reference only. Produce a real cinematic re-render of the first image, premium architectural photography, subtle warm directional bounce and realistic contact shadows, tactile fine-grain materials, lifelike depth and natural highlights like the second image. Lock camera perspective, crop, architecture, openings, all object types, silhouettes and counts, furniture and landscape. Do not add, move or remove anything or import any architecture from the second image. Transform the lighting, reflection, material fidelity and atmosphere as a generative edit. One individual full-frame image.
quality: Same architecture, openings, furniture and equipment counts and positions
Believable bounce, depth and texture; never replace the actual scene by the style reference

exploded.method: Deterministic Blender mesh with two registered book textures
quality: Register footprints on the same scale before extrusion
Use illustrative vertical gaps and slab thickness; do not infer floors

maquette.method: Model separate solid meshes from a trace of the book and render with Blender Cycles
quality: Retain documented footprint, wall position and circulation
Leave uncertain boundaries unmodeled for review
Model furnishings separately; label cut heights and finishes illustrative
